constructions.pattern: set sth up / set sb up
constructions.meaning_cn: 建立、安排或装好；也可指陷害某人
constructions.definition_en: to establish, arrange or prepare something; to frame someone
constructions.boundary: 公司、会议或设备作宾语时是建立安排；人在被指控语境中作宾语时可为设局陷害。代词放中间：set it/him up。

source_evidence.role: semantic support; independently authored bounded correction

constructions.pattern: set off (for a place) / set sth off
constructions.definition_en: to start a journey, or to trigger an event or reaction
constructions.boundary: 不带直接宾语通常是出发；警报、爆炸或反应作宾语时是触发。代词放中间：set it off。

source_evidence.role: semantic support; independently authored bounded correction

constructions.pattern: set out (to do sth) / set sth out
constructions.meaning_cn: 出发；着手打算做；有条理地陈述或摆出
constructions.definition_en: to depart or begin with an aim, or to present something in an organized way
constructions.boundary: to do交代着手时的目标；接事实、理由等宾语时是条理化呈现，代词用set it out。

source_evidence.role: semantic support; independently authored bounded correction

constructions.definition_en: to reserve something for a purpose, or put it out of consideration
constructions.boundary: 时间和钱常是留作专用；分歧和感受常是先搁置；法律判决作宾语时还可指依法撤销。

source_evidence.role: semantic support; independently authored bounded correction

constructions.pattern: set sb/sth back (by a period) / set sb back an amount
constructions.meaning_cn: 延误、阻碍进展；使某人花费一笔钱
constructions.definition_en: to delay progress, or cost someone an amount
constructions.boundary: 进度对象配时间是延误；人后再接金额是口语化花费，不是把人送回。

source_evidence.role: semantic support; independently authored bounded correction

constructions.definition_en: to record something in writing or state a rule
constructions.boundary: 事实、记忆、规则作宾语时，不是把实物放下；代词用set it down。

source_evidence.role: semantic support; independently authored bounded correction

constructions.pattern: be set on sth/doing sth / be (dead) set against sth/doing sth
constructions.definition_en: to be determined to do something or strongly opposed to it
constructions.boundary: on与against都为介词，后可接doing；不同于be set to do的就绪或预期。

source_evidence.role: semantic support; independently authored bounded correction

core_concept.core_meaning_cn: 把事物放到或定在某个位置、状态或标准；名词常指成组的整体
core_concept.core_meaning_en: to place or fix something in a position, state or standard; as a noun, often a related group
core_concept.mental_model_cn: 实物、数值与状态补语分别提示放置、设置或使进入状态；故事被set in是设定背景，太阳set另指落下。名词还按体育、拍摄、设备语境分义；短语中的小词和宾语位置常改变意思。
